This segment additionally returned/read both supplemental complete-family chunks27 families/81 senses and all three supplemental older-body chunks23 complete articles. The sole family overlap is 興奮1238380; the actual deduplicated union is232 families/535 senses and106 older bodies.

All93 original navigation labels and23 supplemental labels were inspected:116 labels, not116 full bodies. Ten original body candidates remain unselected; their identities stay in the unchanged prepared inspection plan. All23 rendering chunks are at most16000UTF8 bytes.

All20 exact source/principal records were read, representing19 distinct principal families/40 senses. All37 complete component records, complete 農/巻/村/濃 bodies and all20 matching public lexical captures were read through EOF.

Preparation plans remain prepared_for_inspection. This separate completed-inspection receipt records actual author returns and hashes; it does not alter the earlier planning artifacts to manufacture completion.

All20 public captures come from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not20 independent dictionaries, fresh reviewer retrievals, frequency measurements or native-speaker certification. Correct modern/read-specific headings were separated from unrelated/historical material.

Twenty source rows map to19 new articles, with 寝間着/寝巻 substantively taught together under1360040. Raw source spellings/readings/glosses including both blank kanji fields and 濃度 brightness are preserved. Unsupported luminance teaching is not carried into 濃度.

Primary Han remain in metadata even where character cards do not exist. Kana primary identities do not inherit Han from body spellings. 寝間着 keeps 寝/間/着 metadata and has a substantive alternate-spelling 巻 link; the variant backlink in both 巻 locations is checked separately from the primary-metadata reciprocal audit.

Quiz guards are direct symmetric nontransitive author hypotheses, not independent verdicts. Actual full labels/bodies and ordinary secondary senses were assessed; neither inherited edges nor category/part-of-speech/state/participant differences are automatic rules.

quizGuardRationale: Directly assess full ordinary secondary senses: 針1366210:6 sewing, 薬1538160:2 efficacious chemical/pesticide and 性能1375470:1 efficiency are not ruled out by the older primary titles.

Boiling/simmering has direct lexical overlap with broader cooking and food preparation, including Kansai-qualified 炊く. Do not copy all 煮える edges, pretend liquids cannot 煮える, or equate liquid cooking with baking/grilling.

Suddenness and immediacy were separately assessed using complete families and bodies, not inherited via the older suddenness clique. 一瞬 duration and 一度に grouping are not automatically sudden occurrence.
Twisting/wringing and turning overlap without making every action identical. Additional睨む judgment/examination/consideration and熱する excitement need direct review beyond the first source gloss.

濡らす explicitly teaches make-wet causation with a translated contrast toぬれる get-wet. This is a specific title/construction judgment, not a blanket transitive/state exemption. Category proximity alone does not equate screws/nails, necklace/ring, sleepwear/all clothing or agrochemical/fertilizer.

狙い purpose/target/intention and狙う desired-goal pursuit were directly assessed. Hope, planning, intention and goal seeking can overlap but are not unrestricted substitutions; assess declared hope/planning guards individually rather than assuming either equivalence or complete separation.

年度 overlaps school-year and broad year labels; a school term is not automatically a whole year. 農村 overlaps village/countryside without making every rural region agricultural; 農産物 overlaps crops/harvest without a plant-only restriction.

濃度 concentration and集中/濃い labels may need conservative direct protections despite actual physical/attention and noun/property distinctions. No inferred brightness/明るさ equivalence is taught. 能率/性能 has actual efficiency support; 能力/効果 are not automatically synonym edges.
